newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutz sells two industrial units.
newsitem.headline: Deutz sells two industrial units.

text.p: German diesel motor producer Deutz AG said on Thursday it has sold two industrial equipment units as part of a reorganization to focus on its core business.
Deutz, which changed its name from Kloeckner-Humboldt-Deutz AG on Jan 1, sold Schmidt-Bretten GmbH and Schmidt-Bretten Nederland to Precision Industries of the U.S.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Both subsidiaries make evaporation and pastuerisation systems for processing milk and other fluid food products.
Deutz was forced into a drastic reorganisation last year after losses hidden by a subsidiary pushed the company to the brink of collapse.

It has already sold off plant construction businesses and industrial land in Cologne under a 1.0 billion mark ($636.4 million) bail-out led by state and local governments and Deutsche Bank AG, its largest shareholder.
